issue_context.title: Browser Console Warning: definePageMeta() is a compiler-hint helper that is only usable inside the script block of a single file component which is also a page.
issue_context.body:
### Environment

Nuxt Version: 3.11.1

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/nuxt-starter-yd5hhb?file=pages%2Findex.client.vue

### Describe the bug

When defining Client-Only Pages, Received this warning.
`definePageMeta() is a compiler-hint helper that is only usable inside the script block of a single file component which is also a page. Its arguments should be compiled away and passing it at runtime has no effect.`

### Additional context

_No response_

_No response_

https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/blob/ff1bb56e3f90472ff7aae69b214e21197c78400b/packages/nuxt/src/core/plugins/tree-shake.ts#L29-L46
